organizationSuggestions: Clear the floor of loose cords, papers and laundry to instantly enlarge the path.
Introduce a multi-tier modular storage rack or shelving unit along the main wall.
Categorize all items on open surfaces into 'Keep', 'Donate', and 'Recycle' bins.

safetyHazards.description: Multiple electrical wires laying completely exposed across the main walkways.
safetyHazards.fixAction: Install self-adhesive cable raceways or zip-ties along the baseboard to completely clear the path.

estimatedItems.insuranceTip: Mount TV securely to the wall to avoid accidental tip-over.
